Task 8  
 
Task  Title : 
Build an Automated Generative AI Email Assistant with API Functions  
Task Description :  
In this task, you will build a Generative AI system that automatically generates and 
processes email replies.  
The system will simulate a real -world business workflow where incoming messages 
are handled by AI, and actions are automatically executed using API -like functions.  
The system should:  
 Accept a user message (simulating a customer email)  
 Use an LLM to generate a professional reply  
 Automatically  process the reply using functions (like APIs)  
 Save and simulate sending the email  
This demonstrates how AI integrates with backend automation systems.  
Task Objectives:  
 Load or call an LLM  
 Generate structured responses (email format)  
 Create API -like fu nctions (save, send, log)  
 Automate the pipeline  
 Handle simple errors (empty input, failed save, etc.)  
Task Scenario Build a system that:  
 User enters a customer message

 Automate the pipeline  
 Handle simple errors (empty input, failed save, etc.)  
Task Scenario Build a system that:  
 User enters a customer message   
 AI generates a professional email reply   
 System automatically formats the email   
 System simulates sending the email   
 System saves the email to a file/database
